- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Zombie-checker cleanup logic | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The cleanup script assumes that `mcp__github__issue_read get_labels` always succeeds in returning the label set. If the call fails (e.g., due to a transient MCP issue), the cleanup logic does not have a defined error handling path and might not archive the stopped session.
  WHY: A transient failure leaves the stopped session visible in the user's session list, requiring manual intervention, even though the issue itself was correctly resumed. Given the fail-open nature of the cleanup script, this is acceptable, but worth noting as a minor correctness limitation.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:161 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When `mcp__github__issue_read get_labels` errors (transient MCP/network failure), the cleanup's predicate "when the source issue no longer carries `ai:claude-blocked`" has no defined branch — the doc tells the agent to read labels but doesn't say what to do on a read failure.
  WHY: a stopped `— blocked on issue` session would neither be archived (read returned no label set) nor be retained with a clear error (no documented path). The resuming session ends its turn without surfacing the failure, leaving an idle session visible in the session list until a human notices. The original checker cleanup at line 159 sidesteps the same class of failure with `(drop `mine` if it errors)`, so an analogous "treat read error as 'label still present, skip archival'" one-liner would close the gap.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:103 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The rename call (`set_session_title`) is added to the issue-mode stop sequence but the doc doesn't say what happens if the rename itself errors.
  WHY: If `set_session_title` fails transiently, the session keeps its pre-stop title (which is whatever stage title it had — e.g. `… — validation 1/3 — blocked`, the very title the PR description calls out for issue #4552), so the new Zombie-checker cleanup at line 161 won't match it and the session is left visible after `/reclarify` resumes — exactly the failure mode this PR is meant to fix.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
